rules.statement: The heirs, whether minors or majors, receive no better interest than the original donee under Kandyan Law and thus lose their contingent interest upon revocation of a deed of gift, allowing the donor to reclaim title.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) Under the Kandyan Law the heirs be they minors or majors get no bet�ter interest than the original donee and they all get only a contingent interest. Therefore once the deed of gift is revoked the said contingent interest terminates and the donor acquires title. Sanction of court is not necessary. rules.statement: The Kandyan Law permits the donor to revoke a gift during their lifetime without requiring the consent of the donee or any other person.
